A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LIFESTATE-BENCH study. All 11 pages of each are readable, including equations, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-3 and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original model evaluations on Hamlet and synthetic narratives, with numerical results in Table 3 and episode-wise analyses in Figure 3.

after.justification: Section 5, Table 3 and Figure 3 retain the study's original experimental outcomes on Hamlet and the synthetic dataset.

M1.justification: Sections 3-5 and Figure 2 retain the same episodic fact-checking framework and memory-testing procedures: direct concatenation, summary concatenation, knowledge editing and LoRA.

E1.justification: Both versions use Hamlet and the same synthetic narratives to evaluate self-awareness, factual episode memory and relationship shifts. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains identical comparator membership: knowledge editing and LoRA for Llama3.1-8B, plus direct and summary concatenation for Llama3.1-8B, GPT-4-turbo and DeepSeek-R1.

E3.justification: The reported settings remain identical, including Table 3's 196 Hamlet and 115 synthetic questions, Table 2's model configurations, character-name replacement and DeepSeek-based scoring from 1 to 100.

E4.justification: The episode-wise and state-dimension analyses in Figure 3 are unchanged, as are the contamination and question-format observations in Sections 4.4 and 5.2.

E5.justification: Both retain Table 3's Avg/Std reporting and the accompanying variability discussion. Neither supplies run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 3 retains every result, including direct-concatenation ACC of 67.3 for DeepSeek-R1 on Hamlet and 75.6 for GPT-4-turbo on the synthetic dataset. Figure 3's plotted results also match.

T1.justification: The state-space, question-answering and episode definitions in Sections 3-4, including equations (1)-(3), are unchanged. Neither version introduces additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the benchmark's contributions, non-parametric methods' advantages and models' difficulties retaining state across episodes.

C2.justification: The explanations of forgetting and relationship-tracking failures remain unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning limited sample diversity and possible Hamlet contamination.

D1.justification: Data-generation and annotation descriptions, model specifications and memory-method details are unchanged. No implementation settings, hardware information or code/data access instructions are added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 2, Table 1 and the complete bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. Reference text merely reflows across pages.

P1.justification: Author affiliations are reordered and revised, including added Peking University and Spin Matrix affiliations. The funding acknowledgment is replaced. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 reformats the affiliation block, removes printed page numbers and slightly reflows references after the shorter acknowledgment. Tables 1-3 and Figures 1-3 retain their displays, captions and placements.

improvement.justification: The methods, experimental evidence, scientific discussion and limitations are unchanged. Affiliation and funding updates, alongside minor layout changes, leave the paper's evidential strength, reproducibility and overall clarity effectively unchanged.
